cursor_page: This JSON is a snapshot for a separate page. It is not a live broker feed.
disclaimer: PAPER ONLY. Monthly 12-month time-series momentum experiment. It had the highest full-period result in the daily study and is not a preregistered winner. Synthetic exposure on underlying prints. Not a broker order, not shares, not options, and not a leveraged ETF. No profit promise. Public data can be delayed or wrong.

algorithm.cutover_note: Cash, fills, and positions already in this file were kept. No historical P&L was inserted. The monthly target arms on the next refresh and the first fill is the next 09:30 open.
algorithm.window: 252 sessions, about twelve months, sign of the adjusted close return
algorithm.fill: next regular-session 09:30 open after the signal
algorithm.frozen_selection_note: That file still names Donchian. It is the original validation record, not this experiment.

financing.label: not_charged
financing.assumption_not_measured: illustrative 5 percent a year on gross notional above equity and 1 percent a year on short notional
financing.note: Those rates are not a broker quote and are not deducted here. Spread, slippage, and the fee stay on their own fill lines.

cap_note: The live cap uses current share value on each closed 5-minute mark and cuts at the next 5-minute open. The daily study can print above 2x at the close because it has no intraday trade. Those two caps are not the same result.

book.daily_loss_stop_note: Trigger when marked equity, including realized P&L, unrealized P&L, and costs, is at or below 90% of the session starting equity ($450.00 on a $500.00 start; the first session starts from $500). Breach flattens every synthetic position and halts new entries for that US session. No automatic resume the same day. A gap can lose more than the trigger. daily-stop exit at the observed mark that first breached (bar open if the open gaps through, otherwise the close), adverse slippage. Trigger only — a gap can lose more than 10%.
book.performance_note: The curve is the forward paper book only: funding plus marks the engine actually processed. Historical prices are not turned into a backtest P&L here. Replay, if run, uses a separate database.

symbols.atr_note: ATR14 is the simple average of the 14 true ranges before the next signal bar. The signal bar is excluded.
symbols.signal_staleness: Latest completed month-end is 2026-10-30 (12-month adjusted return -0.1791, short). 5 completed sessions have passed since that close. The fill is the 09:30 open of 2026-11-09, not an earlier open. No historical P&L was inserted.

data.delay_label: Public Yahoo Finance candles via the yfinance library. Not a broker feed and not a live quote. Values can be delayed, revised, or missing. Adjusted OHLC is used so daily ranges and 5-minute closes stay on one scale. Entries are blocked when the feed is missing or stale during the regular session.
data.quote_policy: No live quote is synthesized. The mark is the last closed 5-minute candle only.

config.slippage_note: Adverse bps on each fill. Default 5 bps. Buys pay more, sells receive less.
config.commission_note: Bps of notional charged on each open and close leg. Default 1 bp. Included in equity and in the daily stop.
config.fill_model_signal: next regular-session 5-minute open, adverse slippage; not the signal close
config.fill_model_stop: daily-stop exit at the observed mark that first breached (bar open if the open gaps through, otherwise the close), adverse slippage. Trigger only — a gap can lose more than 10%.
config.owner_http_note: POST /api/admin requires an owner session and CSRF. Visitors cannot change the book.

costs.label: assumed_stress_scenario_not_measured_quotes
costs.double_count_policy: Spread and slippage are inside the fill price. Fees are cash. Reports do not subtract them a second time.
costs.empty_note: No simulated fills yet, so there is no performance to compare.

hypothetical.note: No recommendations have been recorded by the forward engine. This is a flat funded-waiting line at the hypothetical start, not a backtest.
hypothetical.label: recorded_recommendations_idealized

instrument.options_note: Actual option contracts are not modeled. There is no strike, expiry, contract multiplier, or option bid. The book is synthetic exposure on the stock or ETF print.
